Winter clear rules for kennel doors
This section sets out the routine in plain words
Kennel Door Safety

This section explains the handling standard for kennel doors at Aurelia Skyways. Staff must inspect each door latch before movement, keep animals calm, and use gentle voice cues and steady hands. <<FACT F120>> Any sign of damage, loose fittings, or unusual noise means the kennel is removed from service until the senior coordinator approves it.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk records each handoff clearly and keeps the travel area clean, quiet, and secure. If a traveler arrives with a concern, the agent gives a simple explanation and directs the traveler to the correct service path without delay. <<FACT F027>> The quarantine room must stay locked except for authorized staff, and every kennel there must be checked before use and after cleaning.

Handlers must avoid rough contact and must never leave Luna, Sofia Tanaka, or Noah Vega unattended near open kennel doors. <<FACT F002>> If conditions become uncertain, staff stop the transfer, isolate the kennel, and report the issue at once. Contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for immediate guidance.
